# Magnolia Maids

> Friendly, eco-conscious residential house cleaning in Dallas, TX. Flat rates, Mon–Fri 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST, and savings on every recurring visit. Grand opening December 1, 2026 — the first 100 clients get a 15% founder rate for life.
